title: SLA Duration & Billing Window Calculator
brief: As a billing owner, I want outages measured against our SLA threshold and credited on the invoice, so that customers are compensated when we miss the SLA.

steps.summary: Add the duration parser and the small time helpers it measures with
Add the SLA types: billing tiers, policy, outages and the invoice
Add the invoice generator that measures outages and credits the invoice
Add the tests and README section

probes.question: Under the default policy, from how many outage minutes on does an outage earn a credit?
An outage starts 60 minutes before the end of the billing period and lasts 2 hours. The subtotal is 10000 cents. What credit does generateInvoice give?

items.question: What happens when parseDurationMinutes gets "90" (no unit)?
Under the default tiers, how much credit does a 5-hour outage earn?
An outage started 3 days before the billing period and ended 1 hour into it. What does the invoice credit for it?
options: 5% of the subtotal (for the hour inside the period)
25% of the subtotal (for the whole outage)

items.question: Suppose parseDurationMinutes accepted a bare number such as "90" as 90 minutes. Would the agent's unit tests notice?
options: Yes: at least one unit test fails
No: all unit tests still pass
The tests stop with an error before any test runs
Only the type checker (tsc) would report it
